cases.task: In boltons, remap (boltons.iterutils) does not properly support mapping types from boltons.dictutils. Specifically: 1) Remapping a structure with a FrozenDict crashes with TypeError ('FrozenDict object is immutable') during default_exit because it attempts to call in-place update(). In default_exit, catch (AttributeError, TypeError) when updating Mappings and fall back to constructing new_parent.__class__(new_items). Also add a copy() method on FrozenDict that returns self to preserve immutability. 2) Remapping an OrderedMultiDict loses duplicate keys because default_enter uses ItemsView(value), which only returns the last value per key. In default_enter, if value has items(multi=True) and addlist, traverse value.items(multi=True). In default_exit, if new_parent has update_extend, call new_parent.update_extend(new_items). Add regression tests to tests/test_iterutils.py and tests/test_dictutils.py.
